comment: Reviewed findings only — hashes and paths, never secret values. All 9 entries come from the FULL REMOTE HISTORY (every remote head, which CI checks out with fetch-depth: 0). Entries 1–7: one hardcoded demo admin password in three historical 2025-era commits. Entries 8–9: two 2026-07 demo values (a hardcoded ADMIN_PASSWORD in app/admin/page.tsx and NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_SECRET in a committed .env.local) that exist only on the abandoned branches origin/fix/hero-build-errors and origin/upgrade/buddy-card, are not ancestors of main, and are absent from the current tree. None are provider keys, JWTs or private keys; the hardcoded fallbacks were removed (B3). Rotate any of these values if they were reused elsewhere. ALWAYS fetch every remote head before reviewing or regenerating: git fetch origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*' — a shallow or single-branch clone sees only a subset of commits and produces an incomplete baseline that fails CI.
